annotations.title: Check a US bank routing number

description: Check a nine-digit US ABA routing (transit) number: the check-digit rule, with the weighted sum shown, and what the first two digits indicate (Federal Reserve district, thrift, electronic or traveler's cheque series). Checks the number only; it does not say whether the number is assigned to a bank.

routing_number.description: The nine-digit routing number. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.
